note: Real, dated export shipments confirmed on two independent customs-data views: outbound from Nhava Sheva Sea (INNSA1) and Sahar Air Cargo (INBOM4) to Port Hamad/Qatar (Qatarenergy LNG cooling towers, FRP headers/spools) and Jeddah/Saudi Arabia (NEOM Green Hydrogen, FEP-lined GRV piping), plus a long-running Malaysia lane to Sepadu Tech Services (Port Klang) with B/L numbers from 2018 to 2022. Counter check: ImportKey claims 8763 total shipments / 28 partners / 38 ports, but only 5 detail rows are visible per page (5 seen vs 8763 claimed) — the aggregate figure is unverified, the individual rows are the evidence. Declared HS 293319 (heterocyclic compounds) does NOT match the actual shipped goods: FRP/GRE pipes, spools, fittings and washers under HS 730403, 73082019, 74122090, 39173990. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual piping/FRP range (3917/7304/7308/7412), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer (own plant at B.S.D. Marg, Govandi, Mumbai) that also imports raw materials (Derakane resin from Alta Performance Materials Hispania, Spain; Georg Fischer DEKA fittings, Germany) — i.e. manufacturer with import dependency, not a pure trader. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null (not public in the sources seen). Domestic supply: not verified, no data.
